description: Cancer PRS weight sets for breast, prostate, colorectal, and melanoma. The exact published breast PRS77 is source-verified but remains non-reporting because multiallelic runtime harmonization and palindromic effect-allele orientation are unresolved; its prior 25-marker quarantine is retained as a nested audit record. Active models carry calibrated and calibration_eligible gates: without a validated reference distribution, the engine withholds percentile, z-score, and interval outputs. Raw PRS and absolute lifetime risk are never displayed.

weight_sets.name: Breast cancer (Mavaddat PRS77; runtime blocked)
weight_sets.disabled_reason: The exact published PRS77 is reproducible, but 39 primary GRCh38 loci are currently multiallelic and 2 additional biallelic loci are palindromic without trusted effect-allele strand provenance. The sample schema does not preserve trusted canonical allele-set/full multi-ALT dosage context, so a third allele can be mistaken for a strand flip. Scoring remains fail-closed for all 41 loci.
weight_sets.calibration_note: No source-validated population reference distribution is bundled for this exact implementation. While runtime scoring is blocked, it must not emit a raw score, percentile, z-score, absolute risk, or interval.
weight_sets.license_basis: Mavaddat 2015 article and supplement, CC BY 3.0
weight_sets.development_method: Sum of effect-allele dosages weighted by the natural logarithm of the published overall per-allele odds ratio for 77 susceptibility variants

model_provenance.coefficient_scale: natural logarithm of overall per-allele odds ratio

current_allele_audit.mapping_policy: primary chromosome only; alternate scaffolds excluded
activation_blockers: complete multi-ALT dosage vectors for imputation
trusted effect-allele orientation for palindromic loci

legacy_audit_record.name: Breast cancer (legacy 25-marker audit only)
legacy_audit_record.source_study: Legacy attribution to Mavaddat et al. 2019 — model not reproduced
legacy_audit_record.disabled_reason: The legacy 25-marker subset has no reproducible published model or selection rule; retained only as an audit record pending exact replacement (issue #1934).

legacy_canonical_metadata.name: Breast cancer (BCAC)
legacy_canonical_metadata.calibration_note: Placeholder reference distribution (mean=0/std=1) — NOT a validated reference distribution for this exact SNP subset and ancestry. The engine therefore withholds the population percentile / z-score / bootstrap CI for this score (issue #7). Supply a validated or analytically-derived (e.g. HWE from EUR allele frequencies) reference_mean/reference_std and set calibrated=true to re-enable the percentile.

legacy_audit_record.calibration_note: This source-unverified model is disabled, is ineligible for analytic calibration, and must not emit a raw score, percentile, z-score, or interval. Replace it with an exact published model before enabling scoring (issue #1934).
